items.title: UKRI Enabling AI adoption closes 1 Dec, 16:00
items.text: Seven days left; you need an AI or domain co-lead and your research office's internal sign-off.

items.title: Horizon wave and tidal call opens 3 Dec
items.text: One €43m grant, closing 31 March; consortia are forming now.

items.title: Review of AI wave modelling by physics
items.text: Jiang and Li sort data-driven wave models by which terms of the action balance equation they replace, flagging under-constrained designs.

items.title: Certified neural-network solutions for nonlinear water waves
items.text: Shavit, Wang and Buckmaster train PINNs to near machine precision, then rigorously certify Stokes, Crapper and Wilton-ripple solutions.
